subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman from <Picture 1>: preserve the long straight chestnut-brown hair falling past her shoulder blades, the thin black glasses frames at the side of her head, the fitted dusty-pink sleeveless top, the light-blue denim jeans and her slim upright back-view silhouette. Reference identity, hairstyle, clothing and body proportion; never reference a face, because her face is not visible in this segment.
<Subject 2> is the whiteboard from <Picture 1>: preserve the white board surface, the white metal frame and legs, the two red round magnets at the left of the board, and the existing handwritten "moon" with the cursive line beneath it at the upper right. This is the only writable surface in the scene, and only the blank lower-left area of the board receives new writing.
<Subject 3> is the room from <Picture 1>: preserve the pale sheer curtains behind the board and the soft even daylight coming from the right. Background anchor only, never a second location.

summary:
[reference generation] One continuous 10-second single shot. A woman seen from behind writes four lines of vocabulary on the whiteboard in a fixed order: "moon", then the Chinese characters "月亮", then "mooncake", then the Chinese characters "月饼". No cuts, no dialogue, no camera relocation.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (as framed in the timeline): fully_preserved - identity as seen from behind, hair length and fall, glasses, top, jeans and standing posture. Only the right arm, the shoulder and the weight shift change.
<Subject 2> (as framed in the timeline): fully_preserved - board, frame, magnets and the pre-existing handwriting stay untouched; four new lines are added in the blank area and nothing else is written.
<Subject 3> (background): partially_preserved - curtain texture and daylight direction only.

detailed_description:
【首帧锁定】
<Picture 1> is the exact first frame at 0.00 seconds of this video, fully referenced: framing, camera height, back view, the fall of her hair, the black marker already in her right hand near the existing handwriting, the whiteboard position, the two red magnets and the pre-existing handwriting must all match it at 0.00 seconds. Do not reframe, do not rotate the camera, do not move or resize the board.

【时长与切镜】
Exactly 10 seconds at 24fps. One continuous take with no cuts, no time jumps and no still frames. The camera never leaves its single position except for the one slow push in described below.

【场景】
One interior corner with a whiteboard on a white metal stand, pale sheer curtains behind it, soft even daylight from the right, quiet home-study atmosphere. The room is one continuous physical space; no second location is ever shown.

【动作与板书】
She writes four lines in one left-aligned column in the blank lower-left area of the board, always top to bottom, each new line directly under the previous one, every line on its own horizontal baseline with even spacing between lines.
0.0-1.0s: she shifts half a step to her left, plants both feet, and raises the black marker until its tip touches the board.
1.0-3.2s: she writes the English word "moon" in clear lowercase letters, left to right.
3.2-5.4s: directly below it she writes the two Chinese characters "月亮", one after the other on the same baseline.
5.4-7.7s: one line lower she writes the English word "mooncake" in the same lowercase handwriting.
7.7-9.6s: on the last line she writes the two Chinese characters "月饼", finishing with a short downward flick.
9.6-10.0s: she caps the marker with a click, lowers her right hand, tilts her head back slightly and holds still, looking at the four finished lines; her shoulders settle.
Her writing hand moves continuously and the strokes land in exactly this order; the marker tip never leaves the board for more than half a second, no line is written twice or overwritten, and the four lines stay inside the blank area of the board.

【镜头】
One static shot from behind at chest height for the whole clip, matching the framing and perspective of <Picture 1>. A slow small-amplitude push in only over the final 1.5 seconds so the four finished lines stay sharp and readable at the end. No cuts, no whip pan, no handheld shake, no zoom, no arc.

【光效】
The same soft daylight from the right throughout; no flicker, no colour shift and no exposure jump while she moves.

【画风】
Live-action, realistic, shot on a phone camera, natural skin and fabric texture, realistic denim and cotton materials, soft indoor contrast with gentle highlight roll-off. Not CG, not illustration, no plastic or silicone skin, no beauty-filter smoothing.

【全局约束】
The handwriting on the whiteboard is intentional diegetic content, not a subtitle, caption or overlay: it must be rendered clearly and must never be suppressed by any no-text rule. Only these four lines are newly written; no other words, numbers, logos or captions appear anywhere in frame. The pre-existing handwriting at the upper right is never erased, covered or rewritten. Her face is never shown to camera, no second person enters the frame, and her pose stays a natural standing stance with no posing or turning toward the lens. One continuous take only.

overall_soundscape:
A dry felt marker squeaks across the whiteboard in short strokes with brief pauses between lines, the cap clicks shut once, denim and cotton rustle softly as she shifts her weight, and the room tone stays quiet with a faint electrical hum. No speech, no footsteps, no music coming from inside the scene.
